claim: One alternative operator-bundle classification only; no gradual-search, universal-replication or component-attribution claim.
reviewer_wording_note: The review once describes p_r as an at-least-one-of-32 probability. The frozen specification correctly defines p_r as a one-slot win probability, uses 32*p_r for expected offspring, and uses (1-p_r)^32 for at least one/zero descendants. The imprecise sentence is not adopted and no design change is made.
